name: the flamingo
did: Coastline's Pack-a-Punch works: the mutated flamingo on the lake bed eats your gun and gives it back wearing a beach camo with floaties on it. You can swim properly now instead of sinking straight to the bottom. The Breakwater -- a box-fed semi-automatic 12-gauge -- is on the two-storey's wall and in the box.
onAccept: Your round is saved and the map is rebuilt. You keep your points, your guns and your perks, and the dead hold off for three minutes while you get set.
